sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI's release notes place cached prompts in May 2025, before the earlier models.dev record, but provide no Grok-2 cache rate or change date.

notes: The official source confirms cached prompts existed before the earlier record, but does not establish Grok-2's historical cache prices or whether models.dev's omitted cache fields were an error. The Internet Archive CDX/page requests returned errors or timed out, so no archival pricing snapshot was available to resolve the classification or date.
